title: Describe the difference in accounting for a sale-leaseback versus a failed sale

items.concept: Contrast recognized sale-leaseback (operating leaseback) with failed sale (finance leaseback): control/classification, initial recognition, liability schedules, period-end adjusting JEs, BS presentation, and end-of-term settlement
Number-variant twin of Q1: recompute classification, gain, PV, initial JEs, first-year schedules, and period-end JEs for sale-leaseback vs failed sale
Recognized sale-leaseback with payments in advance: initial sale + ROU/liability + first payment; pure period-end adjusting JE (no cash) each December 31; settlement when ROU/liability reach zero
Classification of transfer as sale-leaseback vs failed sale based on leaseback type (operating vs finance)
Identify which period-end accounts appear under failed sale versus recognized sale-leaseback
